deviations.learned_qarf_v1: Learned QARF-v1 (A001) trains on page labels; ViMDoc has document qrels only and A005 forbids writing them onto pages, so QARF-v1 is not run. Its role as the learned query-level comparator is taken by the matched QARF-SA-v2 of Stage 4, which shares the anchor, loss, config and seeds with QPAF-SA-v2.
